cues.en: This is the Global News podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Oliver Conway. We're recording this at 14:00 GMT on Friday the 25th of September.
cues.zh: 你好，我是奥利弗·康威。现在是9月25日星期五格林尼治标准时间14点，我们正在录制节目。

cues.en: A new test for brain tumours can slash diagnosis time to just two hours.
cues.zh: 一种脑肿瘤新检测可将诊断时间大幅缩短至仅两小时。

cues.en: President Zelensky says the US will allow Ukraine to produce Patriot missiles despite a previous U-turn.
cues.zh: 泽连斯基总统说，尽管此前政策反复，美国仍将允许乌克兰生产爱国者导弹。

cues.en: And a Filipino maid who narrowly escaped execution in Indonesia has been pardoned.
cues.zh: 一名在印度尼西亚险些被执行死刑的菲律宾女佣获赦。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: toner, face wash, bronzer, blush and contour, mascara, lip glosses and lip balms.
cues.zh: 本期还将讨论爽肤水、洗面奶、古铜粉、腮红和修容、睫毛膏、唇彩和润唇膏。

cues.en: Campaigners call for better regulation of skincare and makeup for children.
cues.zh: 活动人士呼吁加强对儿童护肤品和化妆品的监管。

cues.en: A new rapid test for brain tumours can slash diagnosis time to just two hours,
cues.zh: 一种脑肿瘤快速新检测可将诊断时间大幅缩短至仅两小时，

cues.en: meaning patients no longer have to wait weeks for news.
cues.zh: 这意味着患者不必再为结果等待数周。

cues.en: It means surgeons can get results even while they're operating.
cues.zh: 这意味着外科医生在手术过程中也能得到结果。

cues.en: Hospitals in the UK are trialling the test, as our medical editor Fergus Walsh reports.
cues.zh: 英国的医院正在试用这项检测，医学编辑弗格斯·沃尔什报道。

cues.en: Steve Palmer is being wheeled to the operating theatres at Queen's Medical Centre, Nottingham, in the heart of the UK.
cues.zh: 史蒂夫·帕尔默正被推往英国腹地诺丁汉的女王医疗中心手术室。

cues.en: The 55-year-old collapsed a few weeks ago, was diagnosed with a brain tumour and is being prepped for surgery.
cues.zh: 这名55岁男子几周前晕倒，被诊断出脑肿瘤，正在为手术做准备。

cues.en: Hopefully all of it removed, would be great.
cues.zh: 希望能把肿瘤全部切除，那就太好了。

cues.en: Then I can get on with recovery and whatever comes next, and get back to hopefully some normality.
cues.zh: 然后我就能继续康复、面对接下来的一切，希望回归某种正常生活。

cues.en: So this is the scan of Stephen's head made by the computer system.
cues.zh: 这是电脑系统生成的斯蒂芬头部扫描图。

cues.en: In theatre, neurosurgeon Stuart Smith is reviewing MRI scans.
cues.zh: 在手术室里，神经外科医生斯图尔特·史密斯正在查看 MRI 扫描图。

cues.en: This is the right frontal lobe, where the white area represents the tumour within his brain that we're going to be operating on today.
cues.zh: 这是右侧额叶，白色区域就是他脑中的肿瘤，也是我们今天要进行手术的部位。

cues.en: How big is that? So this tumour is about five or six centimetres across in total.
cues.zh: 有多大？这个肿瘤总共大约五到六厘米。

cues.en: More than 12,000 people a year are diagnosed with a brain tumour in the UK alone.
cues.zh: 仅在英国，每年就有超过1.2万人被诊断出脑肿瘤。

cues.en: There are more than 150 different types, and a thorough genetic analysis
cues.zh: 脑肿瘤有超过150种不同类型，全面的基因分析

cues.en: means a definitive diagnosis can take six to eight weeks after surgery.
cues.zh: 意味着手术后可能需要六到八周才能得到明确诊断。

cues.en: Not this time. Once Steve's tumour is exposed, the surgeons carefully select tissue samples undamaged by any of the surgical techniques.
cues.zh: 但这次不用。史蒂夫的肿瘤暴露后，外科医生仔细选取未被任何手术操作损伤的组织样本。

cues.en: This all looks viable; it doesn't look necrotic.
cues.zh: 这些看起来都有活性，不像坏死组织。

cues.en: And then top right. These contain all the genetic information needed to grade and diagnose his tumour.
cues.zh: 然后是右上方。这些样本包含对肿瘤分级和诊断所需的全部遗传信息。

cues.en: They're bagged up and taken to the pathology labs.
cues.zh: 样本装袋后被送往病理实验室。

cues.en: The rapid genomic test was developed by scientists at the University of Nottingham in partnership with hospital clinicians.
cues.zh: 这项快速基因组检测由诺丁汉大学科学家与医院临床医生合作开发。

cues.en: And what we're hoping to have in 90 minutes or so will be a confident, comprehensive molecular classification.
cues.zh: 我们希望在大约90分钟内得到可靠、全面的分子分类结果。

cues.en: The samples are fed into an ultra-rapid sequencing machine the size of a shoebox.
cues.zh: 样本被送入一台鞋盒大小的超快速测序仪。

cues.en: Molecules of DNA pass through a nanopore, or tiny hole, which reveals the tumour's unique genomic fingerprint.
cues.zh: DNA 分子穿过纳米孔，也就是一个小孔，由此揭示肿瘤独特的基因组特征。

cues.en: The nanopore is running now. It's been running for about 20 minutes.
cues.zh: 纳米孔现在正在运行，已经运行了大约20分钟。

cues.en: Dr Simon Payne, consultant neuropathologist at Nottingham University Hospitals, phones the operating theatre with the results.
cues.zh: 诺丁汉大学医院顾问神经病理学家西蒙·佩恩医生打电话把结果告知手术室。

cues.en: Given the bigger picture and those copy number changes, I think this would be most in keeping with a glioblastoma.
cues.zh: 综合整体情况和这些拷贝数变化，我认为最符合胶质母细胞瘤的特征。

cues.en: Neurosurgeon Stuart Smith has taken the call.
cues.zh: 神经外科医生斯图尔特·史密斯接到了电话。

cues.en: Yeah, I think we've probably done as much as we can in terms of taking out the visible tumour.
cues.zh: 是的，我认为在切除可见肿瘤方面，我们大概已经尽力了。

cues.en: Great, well, thank you very much. That's really helpful and that will help us finish up the operation. Yeah.
cues.zh: 太好了，非常感谢。这很有帮助，能帮助我们完成手术。是的。

cues.en: A definitive diagnosis has taken just two hours, with Steve Palmer still on the operating table.
cues.zh: 明确诊断只用了两小时，而史蒂夫·帕尔默仍在手术台上。

cues.en: Stuart Smith says it's an extraordinary medical advance.
cues.zh: 斯图尔特·史密斯说，这是医学上的非凡进步。

cues.en: It seems almost magical that you can do things that quickly, but this adds a whole new level of information that will guide the surgeon.
cues.zh: 能如此迅速地完成这些事情，几乎像是魔法；但这带来了全新的信息层次，可以指导外科医生。

cues.en: and allow us to make more accurate decisions about how much surgery we do.
cues.zh: 让我们更准确地决定进行多少手术。

cues.en: How extensive that operation is.
cues.zh: 也就是手术要做到什么程度。

cues.en: Hi Stephen, how are you? I'm okay.
cues.zh: 你好，斯蒂芬，你感觉怎么样？我还好。

cues.en: Neurosurgeon Stuart Smith is able to feed back the results and a treatment plan to Steve within days rather than many weeks.
cues.zh: 神经外科医生斯图尔特·史密斯能在几天内，而不是数周后，把结果和治疗方案告诉史蒂夫。

cues.en: I'm afraid it's not great news in terms of what type of tumour it is.
cues.zh: 恐怕从肿瘤类型来看，这不是个好消息。

cues.en: It is one of these grade four tumours, and the name for that type of tumour is glioblastoma.
cues.zh: 这是四级肿瘤，这种肿瘤的名称是胶质母细胞瘤。

cues.en: But it does mean chemo and radiotherapy can start sooner.
cues.zh: 但这意味着化疗和放疗可以更早开始。

cues.en: The other benefit of getting all the genetic diagnosis means that we have a full genetic profile of the tumour.
cues.zh: 获得完整基因诊断的另一项好处，是我们能得到肿瘤的完整基因图谱。

cues.en: And that hopefully will open the door to clinical trials for you.
cues.zh: 这希望能为你参与临床试验打开大门。

cues.en: There is a national programme being...
cues.zh: 有一个全国性项目正在……

cues.en: Obviously it wasn't what I wanted to hear.
cues.zh: 显然，这不是我想听到的消息。

cues.en: But for me, getting that quick diagnosis, let's go on to the next phase of treatment.
cues.zh: 但对我来说，既然这么快得到了诊断，那就进入治疗的下一阶段吧。

cues.en: And recovery, and get on to, you know, fighting whatever I've got to fight.
cues.zh: 然后康复，继续去对抗我必须面对的一切。

cues.en: So it did help remove potentially weeks of anxiety.
cues.zh: 所以这确实帮助我消除了可能持续数周的焦虑。

cues.en: Oh God, yeah, absolutely, yeah.
cues.zh: 天哪，是的，当然。

cues.en: Ukraine has been hit hard by Russia's current air campaign.
cues.zh: 乌克兰受到俄罗斯当前空袭行动的重创。

cues.en: Another three people were killed in Kyiv this afternoon.
cues.zh: 今天下午，基辅又有三人死亡。

cues.en: Part of the problem is a lack of missile interceptors, such as the US-supplied Patriots.
cues.zh: 问题之一是缺少导弹拦截弹，例如美国提供的爱国者拦截弹。

cues.en: In July, Donald Trump told Volodymyr Zelensky to 'make them yourself'.
cues.zh: 今年7月，唐纳德·特朗普告诉弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基“自己制造”。

cues.en: Only to then change his mind.
cues.zh: 但随后他改变了主意。

cues.en: Now, though, the Ukrainian president says the US leader has made a final decision
cues.zh: 不过，乌克兰总统称，美国领导人已经作出最终决定，

cues.en: to give Ukraine licences to produce them.
cues.zh: 允许乌克兰生产这种拦截弹。

cues.en: Sasha Schlichter told me more.
cues.zh: 萨莎·施利希特告诉我更多详情。

cues.en: I think President Zelensky is keeping his fingers crossed,
cues.zh: 我想，泽连斯基总统正在祈祷一切顺利，

cues.en: because we know Donald Trump can change his mind
cues.zh: 因为我们知道，唐纳德·特朗普可能改变主意，

cues.en: several times in one day. So
cues.zh: 一天之内就可能变上好几次。因此，

cues.en: his latest opinion, according to Mr Zelensky,
cues.zh: 据泽连斯基先生说，他最新的意见是，

cues.en: the final decision has been made and there will be permission
cues.zh: 最终决定已经作出，乌克兰将获准，

cues.en: its own Patriot interceptors.
cues.zh: 也就是自己的爱国者拦截弹。

cues.en: But it is funny that in July Mr Trump was so keen, he said it.
cues.zh: 但有趣的是，特朗普先生7月还非常热心地这样说过。

cues.en: It would be pretty cool to grant Ukraine the licences.
cues.zh: 允许乌克兰获得许可，那会相当不错。

cues.en: Three weeks later, he said America should be very careful before granting Ukraine authorization,
cues.zh: 三周后，他却说，美国在授权乌克兰之前应该非常谨慎，

cues.en: without any reference to the fact that he was very enthusiastic.
cues.zh: 完全没有提及自己此前其实非常热心。

cues.en: So what happened between these two events? Who knows?
cues.zh: 那么，这两件事之间发生了什么？谁知道呢？

cues.en: Maybe Mr Steve Witkoff had a conversation with his friend Vladimir Putin,
cues.zh: 也许史蒂夫·威特科夫先生和他的朋友弗拉基米尔·普京谈过话，

cues.en: and Mr Putin gave him another history lesson.
cues.zh: 普京先生又给他上了一课历史课。

cues.en: He said that interceptor missiles in the hands of that Nazi, as he calls Zelensky, are a very dangerous thing.
cues.zh: 他说，拦截弹落在那个纳粹手里——他这样称呼泽连斯基——是非常危险的事。

cues.en: And Mr Witkoff, of course, reported this straight to Mr Trump.
cues.zh: 当然，威特科夫先生把这番话直接转告了特朗普先生。

cues.en: So it is all about being very, very sure-footed,
cues.zh: 所以，一切都要非常、非常稳妥，

cues.en: and of course Mr Zelensky should be very careful not to antagonize Mr Trump.
cues.zh: 当然，泽连斯基先生也应当非常小心，不要激怒特朗普先生。

cues.en: So he never recalled him flipping over this issue; he just said it as it is.
cues.zh: 所以他从未回忆起特朗普在这个问题上反复变卦，只是如实转述了情况。

cues.en: But if and when Ukraine gets these licences, it will not be a magic bullet.
cues.zh: 但即使乌克兰拿到了这些许可，也不会立刻解决问题。

cues.en: No, it takes months and months, up to two years, to set up production.
cues.zh: 不，建立生产线需要很长时间，最长可能要两年。

cues.en: You know, building the engine and the rocket itself.
cues.zh: 还要制造发动机和火箭本身。

cues.en: The systems are there; it is just the rockets that are depleted.
cues.zh: 系统已经具备，只是火箭弹库存已经耗尽。

cues.en: And even if it wanted to, Washington could not supply Ukraine now with ready-made rockets,
cues.zh: 而且，即便华盛顿想提供，也无法现在给乌克兰现成的火箭弹，

cues.en: because its stocks have been depleted in the Middle East.
cues.zh: 因为美国在中东的库存已经耗尽。

cues.en: It is a very costly weapon. It costs billions and billions.
cues.zh: 这是极其昂贵的武器，造价要几十亿、几十亿美元。

cues.en: They used it on nothing in the Middle East because they were so keen to show
cues.zh: 他们在中东动用了这些武器，却没有取得什么结果，因为他们急于展示，

cues.en: that it was such a victorious war on Iran.
cues.zh: 这是一场对伊朗取得压倒性胜利的战争。

cues.en: So now the Pentagon has its own stocks depleted,
cues.zh: 所以现在五角大楼自己的库存也耗尽了，

cues.en: and all it can do is give Ukraine a licence to produce.
cues.zh: 它能做的只有给乌克兰生产许可。

cues.en: But I must say that the war has changed completely.
cues.zh: 但我必须说，战争已经彻底改变。

cues.en: Zelensky has said today that Ukraine is working
cues.zh: 泽连斯基今天说，乌克兰正在研发

cues.en: on its own anti-ballistic system, called Freya, with several European countries taking part.
cues.zh: 自己的反弹道系统“弗雷娅”，并有几个欧洲国家参与其中。

cues.en: Our Global Affairs reporter, Sasha Schlichter.
cues.zh: 本台全球事务记者萨莎·施利希特报道。

cues.en: Mary Jane Veloso spent nearly 15 years on death row in Indonesia,
cues.zh: 玛丽·简·维洛索在印度尼西亚死囚牢房度过了近15年，

cues.en: in a case that highlighted issues over the treatment of Filipino domestic workers abroad.
cues.zh: 她的案件凸显了海外菲律宾籍家政工人所受待遇的问题。

cues.en: The former maid narrowly escaped execution by firing squad after being found carrying heroin through an airport.
cues.zh: 这名前女佣因被发现携带海洛因通过机场，险些被行刑队处决。

cues.en: She says she was tricked into it, and she has now been pardoned by the Philippine president.
cues.zh: 她说自己是被骗卷入此事的，如今已获菲律宾总统赦免。

cues.en: Philippine congresswoman Sarah Elago said justice had finally been done.
cues.zh: 菲律宾国会议员萨拉·埃拉戈说，正义终于得到了伸张。

cues.en: The granting of an absolute pardon to Mary Jane Veloso is a victory of the people's movement
cues.zh: 给予玛丽·简·维洛索绝对赦免，是人民运动的胜利，

cues.en: which for the past 15 years has tirelessly fought and stood with her for justice.
cues.zh: 过去15年来，人民运动一直不懈斗争、与她并肩争取正义。

cues.en: I got the details from our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head.
cues.zh: 东南亚记者乔纳森·黑德向我介绍了详情。

cues.en: She was always likely to be pardoned.
cues.zh: 她最终获赦一直是很可能的。

cues.en: There were long negotiations between the Philippines government and Indonesia over her case,
cues.zh: 菲律宾政府与印度尼西亚就她的案件进行了长期谈判，

cues.en: going right back to when she was first sentenced to death.
cues.zh: 谈判最早可以追溯到她首次被判死刑之时。

cues.en: President Marcos finally agreed on what you might call a prisoner transfer.
cues.zh: 马科斯总统最终同意了一项可以称为囚犯移交的安排。

cues.en: An arrangement which had not existed between the two countries back in 2024,
cues.zh: 这项安排在2024年时两国之间还不存在，

cues.en: and that allowed her to be moved back to the Philippines to serve the rest of her sentence.
cues.zh: 它让她得以被转回菲律宾，服完余下刑期。

cues.en: It was commuted from a death sentence to a life sentence because the Philippines did not have the death penalty.
cues.zh: 由于菲律宾没有死刑，她的刑罚从死刑减为无期徒刑。

cues.en: But given the enormous amount of sympathy for her in the Philippines,
cues.zh: 但鉴于她在菲律宾获得了巨大的同情，

cues.en: it was kind of inevitable that, after a decent interval, the president would pardon her.
cues.zh: 总统在适当间隔后赦免她，几乎是不可避免的。

cues.en: Widely expected, it is also a popular thing to do for a president who lacks popularity at the moment.
cues.zh: 这既在预料之中，也很适合眼下缺乏人气的总统借此赢得支持。

cues.en: I mean, inside the Philippines, she was seen very much as a victim of human trafficking.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，在菲律宾国内，她被广泛视为人口贩运的受害者。

cues.en: Those who arranged her journey to Indonesia have themselves been sentenced to life in the Philippines for people trafficking.
cues.zh: 那些安排她前往印度尼西亚的人，也因人口贩运在菲律宾被判无期。

cues.en: And of course, she has always said that the drugs were planted in the suitcase.
cues.zh: 当然，她一直说毒品是被人放进手提箱的。

cues.en: She came from a very poor background, as a migrant worker desperately seeking employment in other countries,
cues.zh: 她出身贫困，作为急于在海外寻找工作的移民工人，

cues.en: That resonates in the Philippines, which sends millions abroad.
cues.zh: 这在每年有数百万人出国的菲律宾引起共鸣。

cues.en: Every year to work, it is part of the economy.
cues.zh: 他们每年外出工作，这已成为经济的一部分。

cues.en: Everyone is used to it, but they also know that these people are very vulnerable to being exploited or trafficked.
cues.zh: 人们都习以为常，但也知道这些人很容易遭到剥削或被贩运。

cues.en: And so I think everyone knew this decision was coming,
cues.zh: 所以我想，所有人都知道这个决定即将到来，

cues.en: and President Marcos has done it, basically, after a decent number of months after her return from Indonesia.
cues.zh: 马科斯总统在她从印度尼西亚回来几个月后，最终作出了这一决定。

cues.en: Yeah, and how did she end up on death row in Indonesia?
cues.zh: 是的，她是怎么在印度尼西亚被判死刑的？

cues.en: She arrived in Yogyakarta, the Indonesian city, in April 2010.
cues.zh: 她于2010年4月抵达印度尼西亚城市日惹。

cues.en: Customs officers there found 2.6 kilos of heroin sewn into the lining of her suitcase.
cues.zh: 海关人员在她行李箱的内衬里发现了2.6公斤缝入其中的海洛因。

cues.en: She had worked overseas before, desperately looking for work, and said the job had been arranged for her.
cues.zh: 她此前曾出国务工，急于寻找工作，并说有人为她安排了这份工作。

cues.en: In fact, she thought she was going for a job in Malaysia, but the organisers suddenly told her to go to Indonesia.
cues.zh: 实际上，她以为自己要去马来西亚工作，但组织者突然让她前往印度尼西亚。

cues.en: She always said the suitcase was simply given to her because she didn't have one to put more clothes into.
cues.zh: 她一直说，别人只是把行李箱给了她，因为她没有箱子放更多衣服。

cues.en: The Indonesian court was unsympathetic.
cues.zh: 印度尼西亚法院并不同情她。

cues.en: At the time, Indonesia was running a very harsh anti-drugs campaign.
cues.zh: 当时，印度尼西亚正在开展非常严厉的禁毒运动。

cues.en: Under President Joko Widodo, the court—frankly, it was a very unfair trial.
cues.zh: 佐科·维多多总统执政期间，这起审判坦率地说非常不公。

cues.en: She didn't speak Indonesian and didn't understand much of what was happening.
cues.zh: 她不会说印度尼西亚语，也不明白发生了许多事情。

cues.en: But the appeals against her death sentence failed, and she was scheduled to be executed in 2015.
cues.zh: 但她对死刑判决的上诉失败了，她原定于2015年被执行死刑。

cues.en: Eight other convicts, including two Australians, were executed.
cues.zh: 另外八名罪犯被执行死刑，其中包括两名澳大利亚人。

cues.en: She wasn't, partly because there was also an anti-drugs campaign in the Philippines at the time.
cues.zh: 她没有被执行死刑，部分原因是当时菲律宾也在开展禁毒运动。

cues.en: President Duterte said for many years that he wouldn't intervene in her case.
cues.zh: 杜特尔特总统多年来一直说，他不会干预她的案件。

cues.en: Only recently has the new government in the Philippines really pushed to get her released.
cues.zh: 直到最近，菲律宾新政府才真正推动让她获释。

cues.en: Our Southeast Asia correspondent, Jonathan Head.
cues.zh: 本台东南亚记者乔纳森·黑德报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast.
cues.zh: 本播客稍后还有内容。

cues.en: As we look into a world where human thought is being replaced by machines,
cues.zh: 我们将探讨一个人类思想正被机器取代的世界，

cues.en: it is so important that the conditions of human dignity
cues.zh: 人类尊严的条件得到维护，至关重要；

cues.en: must be respected and be at the forefront.
cues.zh: 并且必须受到尊重、置于首要位置。

cues.en: On a visit to France, Pope Leo gives his thoughts on artificial intelligence.
cues.zh: 访问法国期间，教皇良十四世谈及他对人工智能的看法。

cues.en: This is the Global News podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻》播客。

cues.en: The World Health Organization has warned that the Democratic Republic of Congo is running short of health workers to treat the continuing Ebola outbreak there.
cues.zh: 世界卫生组织警告说，刚果民主共和国缺少救治当地持续性埃博拉疫情所需的医护人员。

cues.en: Cases have surged by 73% over the past three weeks in North Kivu province,
cues.zh: 北基伍省的病例在过去三周激增了73%，

cues.en: and there have now been more than 3,700 deaths.
cues.zh: 目前死亡人数已超过3700人。

cues.en: Dr Rupa Nara has worked for Médecins Sans Frontières for many years
cues.zh: 鲁帕·纳拉医生为无国界医生工作多年，

cues.en: and says nothing compares to what she witnessed while working for six weeks in Butembo, a city in northern Congo.
cues.zh: 她说，在刚果北部城市布滕博工作六周期间所见的一切，都是无可比拟的。

cues.en: Six weeks doesn't sound like a long time for me.
cues.zh: 六周对我来说听起来并不长。

cues.en: Normally my missions are about six months,
cues.zh: 通常我的任务持续大约六个月，

cues.en: but I will say this: those six weeks felt like six years at times.
cues.zh: 但我要说，那六周有时感觉像六年。

cues.en: It was probably the most difficult thing I've ever done in my life.
cues.zh: 这可能是我一生中做过的最艰难的事情。

cues.en: And luckily I had incredible Congolese staff and colleagues to work with, but it was a very challenging experience.
cues.zh: 幸运的是，我有非常出色的刚果员工和同事一起工作，但这段经历极其艰难。

cues.en: So in Butembo, we have a 30-bed Ebola treatment unit and isolation area.
cues.zh: 在布滕博，我们有一所设有30张床位的埃博拉治疗和隔离病区。

cues.en: And out of those beds, at least 20 to 30% of the cases were paediatric cases.
cues.zh: 其中至少20%到30%的病例是儿科病例。

cues.en: Most of these were children that were quite young.
cues.zh: 其中大多数是年纪很小的孩子。

cues.en: Most of them are children under five years of age,
cues.zh: 他们大多是五岁以下的儿童，

cues.en: on average, one and a half years.
cues.zh: 平均年龄只有一岁半。

cues.en: When you looked at all the kids we were receiving, including newborns, it was incredibly challenging.
cues.zh: 当你看到我们收治的所有孩子，包括新生儿时，那真是极其艰难。

cues.en: One patient in particular that comes into my mind was a young woman
cues.zh: 我尤其想起一名年轻女性患者，

cues.en: with her child, and she had one sandal on.
cues.zh: 她带着孩子，脚上只穿着一只凉鞋。

cues.en: And none of the papers had her name, where she was born, or details of her child,
cues.zh: 她没有任何文件，写着自己的姓名、出生地或孩子的信息，

cues.en: because she had just fled conflict in another area,
cues.zh: 因为她刚从另一个地区的冲突中逃离，

cues.en: and she had lost a lot of her family members to this conflict.
cues.zh: 并且有许多家人死于这场冲突。

cues.en: She came in, and both she and her child had Ebola.
cues.zh: 她来到这里时，她和孩子都感染了埃博拉。

cues.en: And to think about what this poor population is suffering,
cues.zh: 想到这个贫困群体正在承受的一切，

cues.en: it's impossible to understand and realise the pain, the suffering, but also the resilience in this incredible population.
cues.zh: 我们无法真正体会他们的痛苦与磨难，也难以想象这个非凡群体所展现的坚韧。

cues.en: And unfortunately, we did lose that child of hers.
cues.zh: 遗憾的是，我们确实失去了她的孩子。

cues.en: That baby died, and the woman did survive,
cues.zh: 那个婴儿去世了，但那名女子活了下来，

cues.en: but every day it felt impossible.
cues.zh: 可每一天都让人感觉难以承受。

cues.en: We lose a lot of those children.
cues.zh: 我们失去了许多这样的孩子。

cues.en: I think we lost between 80 to 90 percent of these kids while I was there.
cues.zh: 我想，我在那里时失去了其中80%到90%的孩子。

cues.en: It's incredibly challenging.
cues.zh: 这极其艰难。

cues.en: I was mainly there to work both as the paediatrician, but also to train our Congolese colleagues in paediatric management and critical care.
cues.zh: 我主要在那里担任儿科医生，同时培训刚果同事进行儿科管理和重症护理。

cues.en: And that was my silver lining, because I had really incredible staff
cues.zh: 这算是我的一线希望，因为我有一群非常出色的员工，

cues.en: that was risking their life every day.
cues.zh: 他们每天都在冒着生命危险。

cues.en: And although it was a very challenging six weeks, I just got home
cues.zh: 虽然那六周极其艰难，但我刚刚回到家，

cues.en: and I received several messages from my staff over the last two days because we had four kids admitted when I left.
cues.zh: 过去两天我收到了员工的几条消息，因为我离开时还有四个孩子住院。

cues.en: And two of those children have left cured.
cues.zh: 其中两个孩子已经痊愈出院。

cues.en: One was a two-and-a-half-year-old; one's a seven-year-old.
cues.zh: 一个两岁半，另一个七岁。

cues.en: And the two other children that were confirmed—one's a 15-month-old,
cues.zh: 另外两个确诊的孩子中，一个是15个月大，

cues.en: and the other one's another two-year-old—are actually stable and doing well.
cues.zh: 另一个两岁；他们目前都很稳定，情况良好。

cues.en: And it's really nice to hear and see my staff see some hope.
cues.zh: 听到并看到我的员工看到了一些希望，真的很好。

cues.en: Dr Rupa Nara.
cues.zh: 鲁帕·纳拉医生。

cues.en: Beauty products like skincare and makeup have become a big part of young people's lives in recent years, often driven by social media.
cues.zh: 近年来，护肤品和化妆品已成为年轻人生活的重要部分，常常受到社交媒体的推动。

cues.en: In some cases, children may even be harming themselves.
cues.zh: 在某些情况下，孩子甚至可能正在伤害自己。

cues.en: BBC reporter Nina Blissett asked some children what they use.
cues.zh: BBC记者妮娜·布利塞特询问了一些孩子使用什么产品。

cues.en: Toner, face wash, bronzer, blush and contour.
cues.zh: 爽肤水、洗面奶、古铜粉、腮红和修容。

cues.en: Mascara. Lip glosses and lip balms.
cues.zh: 睫毛膏。唇彩和润唇膏。

cues.en: Stuff for my eyebrows.
cues.zh: 还有画眉毛的东西。

cues.en: Cleanser, moisturiser, blush and eyeshadow.
cues.zh: 洁面乳、保湿霜、腮红和眼影。

cues.en: Blush, maybe a bit of concealer and obviously mascara.
cues.zh: 腮红，可能还有一点遮瑕，当然还有睫毛膏。

cues.en: Where do you see all these makeup and skincare products?
cues.zh: 你在哪里看到这些化妆品和护肤品？

cues.en: A lot of people, like, post about it, like their morning routines.
cues.zh: 很多人会发帖介绍，比如他们的晨间护肤流程。

cues.en: Idols, like the public, like social media, I would say.
cues.zh: 我想说，偶像和公众都喜欢社交媒体。

cues.en: I just saw, like, it around, like, TikTok and YouTube and stuff, and I just thought, why not try it?
cues.zh: 我就是在TikTok、YouTube之类的平台上看到它，然后想，为什么不试试呢？

cues.en: Well, Save Face, a British organisation that runs a register of approved beauty professionals, is calling for better regulation.
cues.zh: 英国机构Save Face负责登记获认可的美容专业人员，如今呼吁加强监管。

cues.en: Its founder is Ashton Collins.
cues.zh: 该机构创始人是阿什顿·柯林斯。

cues.en: It's becoming a huge, huge problem and it's only going to get worse.
cues.zh: 这正成为一个极其严重的问题，而且只会越来越糟。

cues.en: And that's why we're calling for this urgent intervention to have clear labelling on products
cues.zh: 因此，我们呼吁紧急介入，在产品上明确标注，

cues.en: to inform parents, children and retail staff that these are harmful ingredients
cues.zh: 告知家长、孩子和零售工作人员，这些是有害成分，

cues.en: for children and they're not suitable for people under 18.
cues.zh: 不适合儿童，也不适合18岁以下人士。

cues.en: Powerful active skincare ingredients like retinols and certain acids work by speeding up skin-cell turnover, and so they're exfoliants.
cues.zh: 视黄醇等强效活性护肤成分和某些酸类，会加速皮肤细胞更新，因此属于去角质剂。

cues.en: And for young skin, whose barriers are really sensitive, it damages their skin and damages it long term,
cues.zh: 而儿童皮肤的屏障非常敏感，这会损伤皮肤，并造成长期伤害，

cues.en: and so it can cause things like burning and contact dermatitis and eczema long term.
cues.zh: 还可能长期引起灼热、接触性皮炎和湿疹。

cues.en: And not just the physical impacts it has on our young children, it's also the mental health impact.
cues.zh: 它影响的不只是孩子的身体，也会影响他们的心理健康。

cues.en: Telling children as young as eight that you need these extensive skincare routines
cues.zh: 告诉年仅八岁的孩子，他们需要这些繁复的护肤流程，

cues.en: or you need to improve the way that you look, I think, is really harmful.
cues.zh: 或者需要改善外貌，我认为这非常有害。

cues.en: We probably naively thought that once these companies realised the impact they were having on young children's health and their mental health,
cues.zh: 我们可能天真地以为，这些公司意识到它们对儿童身体和心理健康造成的影响后，

cues.en: they would step up to the plate and actually, you know, do that.
cues.zh: 就会挺身而出，真正采取行动。

cues.en: Voluntarily, but that isn't the case, which is why we're now calling for government backing to better regulate social media companies
cues.zh: 但事实并非如此，所以我们现在呼吁政府支持，加强对社交媒体公司的监管，

cues.en: and influencers in terms of how they target young children with these types of products.
cues.zh: 规范它们及网红利用这类产品面向儿童的方式。

cues.en: Ashton Collins from Save Face.
cues.zh: Save Face的阿什顿·柯林斯。

cues.en: Although it's a secular state, France remains a nominally Catholic country, albeit with low church attendance.
cues.zh: 法国虽是世俗国家，但仍是名义上的天主教国家，只是教会出席率很低。

cues.en: And there was a warm welcome for Pope Leo today.
cues.zh: 今天，教皇良十四世受到了热烈欢迎。

cues.en: The bells of Notre-Dame rang out as the pontiff landed at the airport to be greeted by President Macron and a military band.
cues.zh: 教皇抵达机场时，巴黎圣母院钟声响起，马克龙总统和军乐队迎接了他。

cues.en: The highlight is expected to be a giant mass attended by more than half a million people in the centre of Paris.
cues.zh: 预计亮点将是巴黎市中心举行的一场大型弥撒，参加者超过五十万人。

cues.en: But in his first engagement of the four-day trip at the Élysée Palace, he issued a warning about AI.
cues.zh: 但在四天行程中于爱丽舍宫参加的首场活动上，他发出了关于人工智能的警告。

cues.en: As we look into a world where human thought is being replaced by machines,
cues.zh: 当我们展望一个人类思想正被机器取代的世界时，

cues.en: it is so important that the conditions of human dignity must be respected and be at the forefront.
cues.zh: 尊重人的尊严并将其置于首位至关重要。

cues.en: It is a question of ethics: to know what morally is good or not. So what are we to make of that?
cues.zh: 这是一个伦理问题：要知道什么在道德上是对的，什么不是。那么，我们该如何理解这番话？

cues.en: I asked our correspondent Hugh Schofield in Paris.
cues.zh: 我询问了在巴黎的记者休·斯科菲尔德。

cues.en: We know that he holds AI as a theme very close to his heart.
cues.zh: 我们知道，人工智能是他非常重视的主题。

cues.en: He's issued his first-ever encyclical, that is, a papal pronouncement on this subject in May.
cues.zh: 他在五月发布了首份通谕，也就是一份关于这一主题的教皇训令。

cues.en: So he named himself Leo XIV after Leo XIII, who was the pope 100 years ago.
cues.zh: 因此，他以一百年前的教皇良十三世为名，自称良十四世。

cues.en: He made some very important pronouncements about changing society then, including industrialization.
cues.zh: 良十三世曾就当时改变社会的问题发表重要论述，包括工业化。

cues.en: He also addressed the proletariat and the need for human input into the changes then.
cues.zh: 他还谈到无产阶级，以及这些变化中需要人类参与的问题。

cues.en: He wants the same now. He wants human beings to consider very deeply the impact of AI.
cues.zh: 如今，他也希望如此。他希望人类深入思考人工智能的影响。

cues.en: And that's the burden of his speech here in Rome, all over the place.
cues.zh: 这就是他在罗马以及各处演讲所承担的重任。

cues.en: It's not unusual that he should say it here because he's got an audience now of France and the world.
cues.zh: 他在这里这样说并不奇怪，因为他现在面对的是法国乃至全世界的听众。

cues.en: And he's again insisting that AI in itself may not be immoral, but it is a dangerous thing which needs to be brought under control.
cues.zh: 他再次强调，人工智能本身或许并不不道德，但它很危险，需要受到控制。

cues.en: And the people who are in control of it need to be themselves ethically very, very conscientious.
cues.zh: 而控制它的人自身也必须在伦理上极其谨慎负责。

cues.en: Now in that speech in front of President Macron and assembled guests in the Élysée, he reiterated the church's opposition to assisted dying.
cues.zh: 在爱丽舍宫面对马克龙总统和来宾发表讲话时，他重申了教会反对协助死亡的立场。

cues.en: Two months after France approved euthanasia for those with incurable diseases, how might that message go down?
cues.zh: 法国批准为不治之症患者实施安乐死两个月后，这一信息可能会得到怎样的反响？

cues.en: It's the church's message. It doesn't vary a jot
cues.zh: 这是教会的立场。教会的说法没有丝毫改变，

cues.en: from everything that the church has said since this debate burst forth many decades ago, about assisted dying and so on.
cues.zh: 自数十年前这场关于协助死亡的争论出现以来，关于协助死亡等等，始终如此。

cues.en: So it is perfectly natural that the pope would say this in France.
cues.zh: 所以教皇在法国这样说完全合乎情理。

cues.en: In front of his audience, the pope's position, the church's position, is opposition to assisted dying.
cues.zh: 在听众面前，教皇和教会的立场就是反对协助死亡。

cues.en: Opposition to anything that detracts from this essential tenet of the sanctity of human life.
cues.zh: 也反对任何有损人类生命神圣这一基本信条的事情。

cues.en: He made the same point about surrogacy, the buying of organs as well.
cues.zh: 他对代孕以及购买器官也表达了同样的观点。

cues.en: These are things which the church has a very strong and known position about. So it's not surprising that he said it here.
cues.zh: 这些都是教会立场非常明确且坚定的问题。因此，他在这里这样说并不令人意外。

cues.en: It was listened to politely. The state, France, has a different view.
cues.zh: 人们礼貌地听取了这番话。法国这个国家有不同看法。

cues.en: It's passed a law, as you say, which allows some assisted dying in certain circumstances.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，法国已经通过法律，允许在某些情况下实施协助死亡。

cues.en: It's simply a stating of sides, and that's important.
cues.zh: 这只是双方表明立场，而这很重要。

cues.en: But of course the Pope only has so much influence in France.
cues.zh: 但当然，教皇在法国的影响力也有限。

cues.en: He says what he has to say. Some people listen, some people don't.
cues.zh: 他只是说出自己必须说的话。有人听，有人不听。

cues.en: Yeah, I mean, how popular is he in France? As things stand, he's very, very popular.
cues.zh: 是的，我是说，他在法国有多受欢迎？就目前而言，他非常受欢迎。

cues.en: I mean, obviously the faithful are extremely excited about him, but on the left as well, people are generally anti-clerical.
cues.zh: 显然，信徒们对他非常兴奋，但左翼人士也同样如此，他们通常反对教权。

cues.en: I think they approve of a lot of what he's had to say about poverty, migration and, of course, AI.
cues.zh: 我认为，他们赞同他在贫困、移民以及人工智能方面所说的许多内容。

cues.en: Hugh Schofield in Paris. And that is all from us for now.
cues.zh: 巴黎的休·斯科菲尔德报道。以上就是我们目前的全部报道。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如需联系我们，请发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can watch our episodes in full by searching for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 在YouTube上搜索 Global News Podcast，即可观看完整节目。

cues.en: This edition was mixed by Mike Campbell and produced by Rebecca Wood.
cues.zh: 本期由迈克·坎贝尔混音，丽贝卡·伍德制作。

cues.en: Our editor is Karen Martin. I'm Oliver Conway.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是奥利弗·康威。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再见。
